claim_verifications.statement: $47B valuation investment by SoftBank in January 2019
claim_verifications.notes: Confirmed in S-1 Series H financing disclosure and SoftBank filings.

claim_verifications.statement: 2018 revenue of $1.82B and net loss of $1.93B ($219,000/hour burn rate)
claim_verifications.notes: S-1 Consolidated Statements of Operations (p. F-4): Total revenue $1,821,750,000, Net Loss $1,927,330,000. Scott Galloway math ($1.927B / 8760 hours = $220,014/hr).

claim_verifications.statement: First six months of 2019 net loss attributable to WeWork of $904.7M on revenue of $1.54B
Community Adjusted EBITDA stripped building-level operating expenses including rent
claim_verifications.notes: S-1 Non-GAAP Financial Measures section explicitly shows formula adding back lease/rent costs.

claim_verifications.statement: WeWork committed to $47.2B in future lease payments vs ~$4B committed member backlog
claim_verifications.notes: S-1 p. 77 Contractual Obligations: Operating lease commitments totaled $47.2B undiscounted; committed revenue backlog was ~$4.0B.

claim_verifications.statement: The We Company paid $5.9M to WE Holdings LLC for the 'We' trademark in 2019
claim_verifications.notes: S-1 p. 199 Related Party Transactions: '$5.9 million of consideration... for We trademarks'. Returned in S-1/A.

claim_verifications.statement: Adam Neumann leased personal properties back to WeWork
claim_verifications.notes: S-1 p. 200: Discloses multiple lease agreements with landlord entities where Neumann owned percentage interests.

claim_verifications.statement: Adam Neumann had 20 votes per share; Rebekah Neumann was on 3-person succession committee
claim_verifications.notes: S-1 p. 11 & p. 195: High-vote stock 20:1; Rebekah Neumann named with Dunlevie and Langman.

claim_verifications.statement: WeWork purchased a Gulfstream G650 private jet for ~$60M in 2018
claim_verifications.notes: Confirmed by WSJ investigative reporting and confirmed in subsequent asset liquidation in late 2019.

claim_verifications.statement: $6B JPMorgan/Goldman debt facility contingent on raising $3B in equity IPO
claim_verifications.notes: S-1 Liquidity & Capital Resources section: Senior secured credit facility expressly conditioned on completion of IPO raising >= $3.0B.

claim_verifications.statement: IPO postponed Sept 17, 2019; Adam Neumann resigned Sept 24, 2019
claim_verifications.notes: Corporate press releases and Form 8-K filings confirm exact dates.

claim_verifications.statement: October 2019 SoftBank rescue valued company at <$8B, preventing November cash exhaustion
February 2021 Delaware Court of Chancery settlement allowed Neumann to cash out ~$480M in stock
claim_verifications.notes: Delaware Chancery Court consolidated docket 2020-0258 settlement notice.

claim_verifications.statement: WeWork filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy on November 6, 2023 with $18B+ liabilities
claim_verifications.notes: Bankruptcy Court District of NJ Case 23-19865 voluntary petition.

claim_verifications.statement: Masa Son 12-minute tour in late 2016 / early 2017: 'In a fight, who wins?... crazy guy... not crazy enough'
claim_verifications.notes: Confirmed by multiple firsthand accounts documented in 'The Cult of We' and Forbes.

claim_verifications.statement: WeWork acquired a $42M stake in Wavegarden wave pool manufacturer
claim_verifications.notes: S-1 p. F-65 note on minority equity investments (Instant Sport S.L. / Wavegarden).
